source_commit_title: grandppltedx: gps: update libmnl to fix GPS week rollover
local_transformation: tools/fix_mnl_mutex.py; exactly the 18-byte region in mnl-mutex-provenance.json changes relative to the pinned replacement. This is a library update, not an 18-byte change relative to the older engine.
validation: All 197 exports retained and all 20 MNL imports used by mnld available; isolated ARM mutex tests and two temporary live request cycles passed. Export compatibility does not establish private layout or hardware compatibility. A later outdoor trial reported one satellite via Android and GSV at12.8dB-Hz, zero used/no fixes, 353526ms elapsed and3532 NMEA callbacks, without GPS process or Android restart. Original GPS libraries were restored. Positioning, Location-setting toggles and cold boot still require testing. No persistent GPS update was installed on the phone.
